editorial:
Picture a hidden mountain town in Colombia where every member of one big family gets a magical gift from their enchanted house. Everyone except Mirabel, the only ordinary kid in the bunch. When she notices the magic starting to crack, she takes it upon herself to figure out what is going wrong and save her family. The whole thing feels warm, colorful, and full of heart, with catchy songs that will stick in your head for days. It is the kind of movie that makes you want to hug your own family afterward.

The animation is gorgeous, the music is top notch, and the family drama feels real even though the setting is pure fantasy. The songs are catchy and the emotional beats land well. On the downside, the story can feel a little crowded with so many characters, and some plot threads wrap up a bit too quickly. Still, if you love family stories with humor and heart, this one is easy to recommend.
endingExplained: In the final act, Mirabel discovers that the magic was never about the gifts but about the family staying together. The house cracks and falls, but the family rebuilds it together, proving their bond is the real magic. Mirabel finally gets her own door, showing she was always part of the family's magic. The ending is hopeful and warm, with everyone reunited and the Encanto restored.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family stories with humor and heart
